verdicts.target_binary: usr/sbin/httpd (mini_httpd-derived, mipsel, stripped) — no /devinfo handler anywhere
evidence: grep -ri devinfo <rootfs> (all 890 files, binary-aware) -> 0 hits; strings -a loop over every ELF in sbin/ + usr/sbin/ + usr/bin/ + lib/*.so -> 0 hits: the string 'devinfo' does not exist anywhere in this firmware, so no URI-matching handler for it can exist
strings -a usr/sbin/httpd | grep -iE '^area$|notice' -> 0 hits: the CVE's parameter name 'area' and value 'notice' are also absent from the HTTP handler

objdump -d httpd: ws_select_service @0x40c8e0 strips the leading '/' (caller 0x407d34: a1=path+1), then strncmp(path, name, strlen(name)) against the runtime service table (0x443b34, filled by hook_web_services @0x40bfd0 with names at rodata 0x4314c0-0x4314e7: 'uir','fwupg','das','bakset','log','esp','fldown'); paths without '/' fall to default service *(0x4431a0) = ws_uir (rescue mode swaps default to fwupg only when chdir('/usr/www') fails: 0x40b790 chdir@GOT 0x443964 -> 0x40b7dc flag=1 -> 0x40b918 hook_web_services)

ws_uir request handler @0x429a98: page = svc+0x14 (default 'index.htm' 0x43267c), then open(page, 0) (GOT 0x4438a0 = open) at 0x429b10-0x429b24; on open() failure with page != 'atsq.txt' (0x4324c4) it sets svc->status = 404 at 0x429bf4-0x429bfc and returns -1 -> GET /devinfo yields 404, not info disclosure
'common/info.cgi' string in httpd (0x42ff54, xref 0x404ba8) is only a content-type rule for POST form parsing (application/x-www-form-urlencoded at 0x42ff64), not an info endpoint

companion processes checked (agent.md 4.e): sbin/httpdld = TR-069/OpenAgent diagnostics daemon (strings: /etc/OpenAgent/diagnostics/udpechodiag.info, http_uldiag.info, http_dldiag.info) — no devinfo/chkisg/URI handling; usr/bin/uvm = standalone Uy decoder — no devinfo; lib/*.so — no devinfo; no URI-name IPC forwarding exists
verdicts.reason: Device is in the advisory list and build date (2019-10-02) precedes the 20240112 cutoff so the version gate passes, but the /devinfo endpoint does not exist in this firmware generation: the string is absent from every file/binary, and httpd's page dispatch (ws_uir) simply open()s the requested page as a file under /usr/www and returns 404 when missing — no handler, no parameter, no disclosure.

verdicts.vuln_type: authenticated command injection (shell command in chkisg.htm Sip parameter)
verdicts.target_binary: usr/sbin/httpd (Uy-template VM web server) — chkisg.htm page removed in Rev C3 generation

sink.func: popen (UVM 'Shellex NG' engine, httpd @0x432888 'Shellex NG: %s', popen import) — present in binary but NOT reachable via chkisg.htm because the template file does not exist

evidence: version gate: advisory text 'DWR-921 through 2.02' (published 2018-10-17) refers to the Rev A/B v2.x firmware line; this target is Rev C3 v1.01.3.010 built 2019-10-02 (changes.txt 'Firmware: 1.01.3.010 / Date: 2019/10/02') — one year AFTER the CVE, different hardware revision and codebase generation, so the version schemes are not comparable (numerically 1.01.3.010 < 2.02, hence gate recorded unclear and existence decided by code evidence)

ls usr/www | grep -ci htm -> 61 .htm files, none named chkisg.htm; grep -r 'chkisg' over whole rootfs (incl. plaintext Uy string tables) -> only 2 hits, both client-side JS: internet_prim.htm 'GURL("chkisg.htm?rc=&Ntp=0&Sip="+fg.I00110001.value+"&Ssb="+fg.I00110002.value+"&Sgw="+fg.I00110003.value...)' and internet_keepalive.htm same go_chkisg() — the exact CVE attack surface referenced by leftover JS but the target page itself was removed

strings -a usr/sbin/httpd | grep -iE 'chkisg|chk-gw' -> 0 hits; loop over every ELF in rootfs -> 0 hits: no hardcoded URI interception for chkisg.htm and no companion chk-gw script anywhere (the DWR-512 Rev B chain's secondary sink /usr/bin/chk-gw does not exist here)
strings -a usr/sbin/httpd | grep -xE 'Sip|Ssb|Sgw' -> 0 hits: the server side has no handling of the Sip/Ssb/Sgw parameters (they exist only inside the two Uy files' client-side JS blobs)

ws_uir handler @0x429a98: page open() at 0x429b10 fails for chkisg.htm (file absent) -> svc->status=404 at 0x429bf4; UVM magic check 'Uy' (0x7955) at 0x429c3c is only reached for existing files, so no Uy program (and no Shellex popen) can run for this URI

exhaustive sweep of all 61 htm/xml Uy string tables for command-injection patterns (chk-gw, chk_gw, ifconfig, 'route ', 'ping ', nslookup, traceroute, /bin/) -> only fixed commands found: '/bin/date -R' (stat.xml, sync.xml, sys_sntp.htm), 'network_scan 0 &' (network_shell.htm, fixed argument, no bound user variable), 'rm -rf /tmp/www3/atsq.txt' (httpd rodata) — none takes a user-controlled parameter

form handler names enumerated in httpd (form_admin, form_apply, form_emailsetting, form_log_dnsquery_enable, form_login, form_logout, form_macfilter, form_mydlink_log_opt, form_network, form_portforwarding, form_triggedevent_history_enable, form_wansetting, form_wireless, form_wireless_5g, form_wlan_acl) — no gateway-check form

companion processes checked (agent.md 4.e): sbin/httpdld (OpenAgent diagnostics), usr/bin/uvm (Uy decoder), lib/*.so — none references chkisg/Sip/chk-gw; the only popen-capable sink is httpd's embedded UVM Shellex engine which requires an existing Uy template file
verdicts.reason: The chkisg.htm page (the CVE's entire entry point) does not exist in this Rev C3 build — it was dropped from the www image, leaving only dead client-side JS references — and no hardcoded handler, no Sip/Ssb/Sgw server-side parameter handling, and no chk-gw companion script exist, so the injection chain is unreachable; the UVM popen sink itself is present but only fires for existing Uy templates, none of which embeds a gateway-check command.
